# Respo Code for PI Curves

                     "Halimeda discoidea" = "#66A61E",  #green
                     "Caulerpa sertularioides"= "#20B2AA",  # green
                     "Dictyosphaeria cavernosa" = "#239665",  # green
                     "Acanthophora spicifera"   = "#E41A1C",  # red
                     "Gracilaria salicornia"= "#FFA500",  # red
                     "Spyridia filamentosa" = "#7C0A02",  # red

#### Define Model
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

### Define final Platt photoinhibition model
# Platt et al. (1980) Photoinhibition Model ###
platt_model <- function(light_value, Ps, AQY, beta, Rd) {
  Ps *(1 - exp(-(AQY*light_value / Ps))) *exp(-(beta * light_value / Ps)) - Rd
}
```

#### MODEL PARAMETERS  
* Ps = photosynthetic scaling parameter, maximum light-saturated photosynthetic rate  
* Pmax = fitted maximum photosynthetic rate (aka Pm), actual peak photosynthetic rate  
* AQY = alpha = initial low-light slope  
* beta = photoinhibition parameter  
  * beta = 0 little/no photoinhibition  
  * larger beta = stronger photoinhibition (high light decline)  
* Rd = dark respiration  

*Calculate eventually:*   
* Ik = saturation  
* Ik = Ps/alpha = Pmax / AQY  
* Iopt = actual fitted irradiance where photosynthesis peaks, PPFD where the curve peaks before photoinhibition decline  
* if beta = 0, no Iopt b/c no decline, Iopt would be beyond range/approaching infinity  


**Pmax = "Am" = (max photosynthetic rate) **
    * should be positive based on range of umol.cm2.hr - here ~0-2
    * fitted maximum gross photosynthetic capacity, can be higher than highest observed net rate b/c model estimates gross capacity and then subtracts respiration

**AQY (apparent quantum yield) = alpha**
    # should be positive and between 0-1 (often much smaller)
    # high alpha -> alga responds strongly to small increases in light)
    # initial slope of the PI curve at low irradiance
    # represents photochemical efficiency at low light

**Rd = dark respiration**
    # should be subtracted and usually between -2-0 but can adjust if larger
    # magnitude of the negative dark metabolic rate
    # fitted magnitude of dark respiration, the equation ends in - Rd, 
    # predicted net rate in darkness


```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# lists to save outputs from each individual Platt Model fit
coef_list <- list() # fitted parameters for each individual
curve_list <- list() # smooth fitted curve for each 
raw_list <- list() # observed raw data for each
```


### Forloop
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

  # make forloop
  for (i in unique(RespoR_Normalized$algae_id)) {
    # subset one individual's PI curve
    data <- RespoR_Normalized |>
      filter(algae_id == i) |>
      arrange(light_value)
    
    # identify species and zone 
    sp <- data$species[1] 
    sp_name <- data$species_name[1] # full species name
    z <- data$zone[1] # zone
    cat("\nModel 2:", sp, z, i, "\n") # catenate
    
    # use nls_multstart to fit the photoinhibition curve
    # nonlinear models where we dont know best starting parameter values
    curve.platt <- tryCatch(nls_multstart(
      umol.g.hr ~ platt_model(light_value, Ps, AQY, beta, Rd),
      data = data,
      iter = 500, # try 500 different starting values within the range below
      start_lower = c(Ps = max(data$umol.g.hr, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5, # ranges of starting values
                      AQY = 0.001, beta = 0.0001, Rd = abs(min(data$umol.g.hr, na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.5),
      start_upper = c(Ps = max(data$umol.g.hr, na.rm = TRUE) * 3, AQY = 0.5, beta = 0.5,
                      Rd = abs(min(data$umol.g.hr, na.rm = TRUE)) * 2),
      lower = c(Ps = 0.000001, # cannot be 0 b/c light value/Ps cannot be divided by 0
                AQY = 0.000001, beta = 0,Rd = 0),
      supp_errors = "Y"),
      
      # if one individual fails, continue to the next one
      error = function(e) {
        message("MODEL 2 FAILED FOR ", i, ": ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
      }
    ) 
    # skip to next individual if Model 2 failed
    if(is.null(curve.platt)) {
      next
    }
    
    # extract fitted coefficients
    coefs <- coef(curve.platt)
    
    # calculate Pmax value from Platt model
    Pmax_val <- coefs["Ps"]* (coefs["AQY"] / (coefs["AQY"] + coefs["beta"])) *
      (coefs["beta"] / (coefs["AQY"] + coefs["beta"])) ^(coefs["beta"] / coefs["AQY"]) # see equation in Platt 1980
    
    # calculate Ik
    Ik_val<- Pmax_val/coefs["AQY"] # Ik = Pmax/AQY
    
    # calculate Iopt b/c if beta =0, there is no finite photoinhibition optimum
    # so Platt model would go toward a more non-photoinhibited curve
    if(coefs["beta"] > 0.000001) {
      Iopt_val <- (coefs["Ps"] / coefs["AQY"]) *
        log((coefs["AQY"] + coefs["beta"]) / coefs["beta"]) # Iopt accounts for beta
      
    } else {
      Iopt_val <- NA
    }
    
    coef_print <- coefs |> # make df like before
      t() |>
      as.data.frame() |> 
      mutate(Pmax = Pmax_val, Ik = Ik_val, Iopt = Iopt_val, species = sp, species_name = sp_name, zone = z, algae_id = i,
             model = "Platt_photoinhibition", AIC = AIC(curve.platt))
    
    coef_list[[i]] <- coef_print # save Ps, alpha, beta, Rd, Iopt, AIC
    
    # make smooth light sequence for fitted curve
    curve_df <- tibble(light_value = seq(0, 900, by = 5)) |>
      mutate(pred_rate = platt_model(light_value, Ps = coefs["Ps"], AQY = coefs["AQY"],  # photosynthetic rate predicted by Platt model
                                     beta = coefs["beta"], Rd = coefs["Rd"]),
             species = sp, species_name = sp_name, zone = z, algae_id = i)
    
    curve_list[[i]] <- curve_df # save curve
    
    raw_list[[i]] <- data |> # save raw observations
      dplyr::select(species, species_name, zone, algae_id, light_value, umol.g.hr)
  }
```


**Combine PI Model Outputs**   
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# one row per individual with fitted parameters (Pmax, alpha, beta, Rd, Ik, Iopt)
PI_individuals <- bind_rows(coef_list)

# all individual fitted curves
PI_curve_data <- bind_rows(curve_list)

# raw data points for each individual
PI_raw_data <- bind_rows(raw_list)

#View(PI_individuals)
```


**Summary Table of PI Curve Fitted Rates**  
Mean and standard error of individual PPFD curves that were fitted.  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# mean +/- SE of individual PPFD curves table 
PI_curve_summary<- PI_curve_data |>
  group_by(species, species_name, zone, light_value) |>
  summarise(mean_rate = mean(pred_rate, na.rm = TRUE), n = n_distinct(algae_id),
            se_rate = sd(pred_rate, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),.groups = "drop")

PI_curve_summary
```

**Define y-axis limits to make plots easier to compare**
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false


# common y-axis limits for all PI curve plots
PI_y_limits <- range(c( PI_raw_data$umol.g.hr,
                        PI_curve_data$pred_rate ),na.rm = TRUE)

```


### INDIVIDUAL PLOTS  
#### Fit Individual PPFD (PI) Curves  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

## Individual curves for each sample (140)
PI_individuals_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = PI_raw_data, # observed points
             aes(x = light_value, y = umol.g.hr, color = species), # plot raw data
             size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = PI_curve_data, # fitted Platt curve
            aes(x = light_value, y = pred_rate, color = species, group = algae_id), # plot predicted rates
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +# line at net photosynthesis = 0
  scale_color_manual(values = species_palette) + # color palette
  facet_wrap(~ algae_id, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") + # put all plots on one 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 900, by = 100)) + # x-axis scale
  labs(x = expression("PAR ("*mu*"mol photons "*m^-2*s^-1*")"), # or Photon Flux Density?
       y = expression("Net Photosynthesic Rate ("*mu*"mol O"[2]*" g"^-1*" h"^-1*")")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

### PI Curve Figures  

#### Within-species: inshore vs offshore  
Only 4 species were found both inshore and offshore. This figure compares their PI curves between inshore and offshore.  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# pull out species found in both zones
both_zones <- PI_individuals |>
  distinct(species, species_name, zone) |>
  count(species, species_name) |>
  filter(n == 2, !species %in% c("cs", "ds", "da")) |> # check if in both zones and keep only those, remove cs, ds, da for this discussion
  pull(species) # species codes

both_zones
```

**Intraspecific differences between inshore and offshore zones**  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false


PI_within_species <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = PI_raw_data |>  # raw individual observations in background
               filter(species %in% both_zones),# just the species in both zones
             aes(x = light_value,y = umol.g.hr, color = zone),
             alpha = 0.2,size = 1)+
  geom_ribbon(data = PI_curve_summary |> # SE around mean individual fitted curves
                filter(species %in% both_zones),# just the species in both zones
               aes(x = light_value, ymin = mean_rate - se_rate,
                   ymax = mean_rate + se_rate, fill = zone),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = PI_curve_summary |>  # mean individual fitted curve
              filter(species %in% both_zones), # just the species in both zones
            aes(x = light_value,y = mean_rate,color = zone),
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,linetype = 2,color = "grey50") + # add a l;ine where net photosynthesis = 0
  facet_wrap( ~ species_name) + #facet by species
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = PI_y_limits) + # y axis comparable 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("inshore" = "#90E4C1","offshore" = "#31688e")) + # colors for zones
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("inshore" = "#90E4C1","offshore" = "#31688e")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 900), breaks = seq(0, 900, by = 200))+ # fix x axis breaks
  labs(title = "Intraspecific Differences Between Zones",
       x = expression("PAR ("*mu*"mol photons "*m^-2*s^-1*")"),
       y = expression("Net photosynthesis ("*mu*"mol O"[2]*" g"^-1*" h"^-1*")"),
       color = "Zone",fill = "Zone") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11))

PI_within_species
#ggsave(here("Output", "PI", "PI_plots", "PI_within_species"))
```

### Individual Parameter Tables
* Pmax (Ps)
* AQY
* beta
* Rd
* Ik
* Iopt
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

PI_parameter_individuals <- PI_individuals |>
  dplyr::select(species,species_name, zone, algae_id, Pmax, AQY, beta,
         Rd, Ik, Iopt,AIC) |>
  arrange(species, zone, algae_id)

PI_parameter_individuals
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# put parameters into long format 
PI_parameters_long <- PI_parameter_individuals |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Pmax, AQY, beta, Rd, Ik, Iopt),
               names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value")
```


### Parameter Means for all species and zones
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Parameter means +/- SE #####

PI_parameter_summary <- PI_parameters_long |>
  group_by(
    species,
    species_name,
    zone,
    parameter
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#View(PI_parameter_summary)

PI_parameter_table <- PI_parameter_summary |>
  mutate(
    mean_SE = paste0(
      round(mean, 2),
      " ± ",
      round(se, 2)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    species,
    species_name,
    zone,
    parameter,
    n,
    mean_SE
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = parameter,
    values_from = c(mean_SE, n)
  )

View(PI_parameter_table)
```


### Parameter Comparison Figures

**Make species name label**  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

PI_parameters_long <- PI_parameters_long |>
  mutate(species_label = paste0("<i>", species_name, "</i>"))

PI_parameter_summary <- PI_parameter_summary |>
  mutate(species_label = paste0("<i>", species_name, "</i>"))
```

**Make parameter comparison plot of means**  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

PI_parameter_plot <- ggplot() +
  
  # individual parameter estimates
  geom_point(
    data = PI_parameters_long,
    aes(
      x = species_label,
      y = value,
      color = zone
    ),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      dodge.width = 0.6
    ),
    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # mean +/- SE
  geom_errorbar(
    data = PI_parameter_summary,
    aes(
      x = species_label,
      ymin = mean - se,
      ymax = mean + se,
      color = zone
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # mean
  geom_point(
    data = PI_parameter_summary,
    aes(
      x = species_label,
      y = mean,
      color = zone
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ parameter,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Parameter value",
    color = "Zone"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

PI_parameter_plot

```
